method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (wcra-core.l4, with 13 regulative rules for the duties of the claimant, the worker, the employer and the insurer) and two seat layers (wcra-seat.l4 for the injured worker, wcra-seat-insurer.l4 for the insurer) that restate no rule; no REFUSE (a day with no deposited QOTE answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Workers' Compensation and Rehabilitation Act 2003 (Qld) act-2003-027, the current in-force version on 22 September 2026 (in force from 1 January 2025, still current on 20 October 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2003-027.txt; with the Workers' Compensation and Rehabilitation Regulation 2025 (sl-2025-0116, in force from 1 September 2025, retrieved 20 October 2026) and the Workers' Compensation and Rehabilitation (QOTE) Notice 2026 (sl-2026-0044, in force from 1 July 2026, retrieved 20 October 2026: QOTE for 2026-27 $1,994.50, 2.1% up on 2025-26), as deposited in their own subjects under subjects/au/qld/
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0, State of Queensland, with the attribution in SOURCE-LICENSE.md (the Act) and in the Regulation's and the Notice's own SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run wcra-core.l4 ; l4 run wcra-seat.l4 ; l4 run wcra-seat-insurer.l4 ; l4 run wcra-cases-worker.l4 ; l4 run wcra-cases-insurer.l4
checks.result: 264 assertions satisfied (wcra-cases-worker.l4 210 of 210, wcra-cases-insurer.l4 54 of 54, including 16 mirror cases), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24, after the fixes of findings 17-20); 14 #TRACEs with an expect line (8 breaches, 6 obligations or permissions pending), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: s 10A with the QOTE Notice 2026; s 11 and schedule 2 (worker), s 30 and schedule 3 (employer), s 109 (who pays); ss 32-36 (injury, recess, journeys), s 113(1) as a fact; s 106 with Regulation ss 105-109 (NWE); ss 108, 119; ss 131, 132 with Regulation s 110, 132AA with Regulation s 209, 133, 134, 136, 141 (claim, time limits, back-payment, decision); s 140 (maximum 216.15 x QOTE); s 144; s 144A; s 146B with Regulation s 15; ss 147, 148, 150-155 (total incapacity, three periods); ss 162-163 (partial incapacity: LE, MC and the cap only; the s 163(2) formula is missing from the deposit); ss 169, 170; ss 171-174, 176 (redemption); ss 178-181, 185-190 with Regulation s 117, and ss 237(3), 239 (DPI lump sum, notice, disagreement, offer, decision windows, the election); ss 192, 193 with Regulation ss 118, 119, 121 and schedules 3, 4 (additional lump sums); ss 194-201A (death); s 205 (automatic variation and $5 rounding); ss 224-225 with Regulation s 147 and schedule 8 (caring allowance); s 220(3)-(4); ss 231, 232; s 232B. Out: premiums and self-insurance (chapter 2), chapter 1 part 4 division 3 persons, industrial deafness, terminal latent onset and pneumoconiosis (beyond the s 194(2) not-covered value), s 193A, chapter 4 medical treatment, chapter 4A, the chapter 5 damages procedure, reviews and appeals (pointers only), ss 202, 204, 221, 226-229, 232C-232D. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991, income-tax-assessment-act-1997, taxation-administration-act-1953 and fair-work-act-2009 (links in NOTES.md); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seats: the insurer (WorkCover Queensland or a self-insurer)
